first.rationale: I intend to test a shorter onboarding flow because completion and activation are both declining. The test should be limited to suitable self-serve accounts, retain the full flow for complex-workspace accounts, and include qualified revenue and 30-day retention guardrails. I want to verify the prior onboarding result and activation-messaging evidence before committing, since the earlier onboarding change increased churn in complex workspaces and messaging may be a safer alternative.

final.rationale: Run a standard activation-messaging experiment this week. The verified result shows activation improves 6%, week-one engagement 11%, and 30-day retention 1%, directly addressing the activation decline while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Do not shorten onboarding broadly because the verified evidence shows materially higher churn in complex-workspace accounts. Measure activation, qualified revenue, and retention against a control.
